newsitem.title: USA: Quick & Reilly, Liberty, to sell annuities.
newsitem.headline: Quick & Reilly, Liberty, to sell annuities.

text.p: Quick & Reilly Inc said Friday and Liberty Financial Co's Independent Financial Marketing Group said Friday they will launch a program to sell annuities to discount brokerage clients.

Independent Financial will train Quick & Reilly personal brokers to sell fixed, variable and indexed annuities from a number of carriers including Keyport Life Insurance Co another of the Liberty Financial Cos.
Independent Financial will provide product and educational training, conduct customer seminars at Quick & Reilly branches, and help prepare selling materials.
Quick & Reilly's annuity programs will make available a variety of annuity products from mutual funds and insurance companies.

Initially, annuities will be offered to Quick & Reilly investors in 15 states, including New York, Florida, and California, with plans to make the program available in the rest of the country in coming months.
